Maya: Quick hats-off — we just hit 100M inference requests this month. Huge. Mini celebration in the pantry at 3:30? 🪅
Samir: woah awesome. 100M is wild. +1 for pantry. should we do anything low-key (no glitter)?
Olivia: bring my plant adoption table idea back — free succulents for the first 20 people? :seedling:
AJ: @Maya can we get the coffee cart to swing by instead of pastries? more sustainable ☕️
Kai: I can bring my ukulele and play a few tunes for a 5-min interlude if people want 
DevBot: deploy-bot: congrats team! metric: inference.requests.month=100,023,412 :tada:
Maya: love all of this. I'll reserve the pantry space and order compostable cups. succulents OK. Kai yesss on ukulele :smile:
Samir: I will bring a box of herbal tea and some no-sugar cookies
Olivia: quick poll — react with :coffee: for coffee cart, :tea: for tea station, :cookie: for cookie tray
AJ: :coffee:
Kai: :coffee: :ukulele: (thumbs if you want a short set)
Maya: ok coffee cart + succulents + 3:30 pantry. if you want to bring something tag me. thanks team ♥️
